statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Every one of the 24 published hours falls inside the scheduled weekend halt of CME equity-index futures and the NAS100 CFD, so no pathological Nasdaq-100 price path can form inside the window, while the rate, energy and diplomatic backdrop behind elevated Stress remains unresolved.
recommendation: Tail stays far below the block threshold for every published hour because no tradable Nasdaq-100 venue exists before Sunday 22:00Z, roughly twenty hours beyond the final slot. Elevated Stress describes a 5.18% 10-year yield, $92.44 WTI and unaccepted Iranian Hormuz terms rather than any observed mean-reversion failure. Reopen gap risk falls outside this window.
headline: Nasdaq-100 remains inside the scheduled CME weekend closure after an orderly Friday advance; Tail at its floor with Stress elevated on a post-GFC-high 10-year yield, $92 crude and unresolved Hormuz diplomacy
body: Friday's session closed in orderly, two-sided fashion and no Nasdaq-100 venue has traded since. Cash NDX finished 30,608.14, up 129.28 points or 0.42%, inside a 30,413.59-30,667.56 range and about 0.19% below the session high, against a 30,478.86 previous close. NQ December 2026 futures last printed 30,921.75, up 155.00 or 0.50%, within a 30,679.00-30,997.25 range and roughly 0.24% below their own high. VIX fell 5.11% to 14.87 in a 14.68-15.94 range from a 15.67 previous close. All three major US averages posted weekly gains: the Dow rose 0.93% to 51,828.60, the S&P 500 rose 0.51% to 7,743.41 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.48% to 27,068.72. Retracements occurred repeatedly through the session and the index did not hold an extreme into the close, so none of the mean-reversion-failure amplifiers this contract requires were present when the tape stopped. CME equity-index futures settled at 21:00Z on Friday and do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, roughly twenty hours past the final published hour, so every slot in this assessment sits inside a scheduled closure with no tradable venue. That is why Tail is held near its floor rather than inferred from Friday's mildly positive tone. The environment behind elevated Stress is genuinely unresolved. The Federal Reserve's H.15 release for September 24 shows the 10-year Treasury constant maturity at 5.18%, its highest level since the global financial crisis, with the 2-year at 4.87% and the effective federal funds rate at 3.88%. The Fed raised rates 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00% on September 16 and the next decision is October 28, which markets still treat as live. WTI settled at $92.44, down 2.29% in a $91.51-$94.75 range, after Iran's foreign minister proposed at the UN General Assembly to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days in exchange for lifting the US naval blockade, waiving sanctions on Iranian oil sales and observing a ceasefire including Lebanon. Washington has not accepted those terms; the White House described conversations with mediators as positive and constructive on Friday, while reporting also notes the president is in no rush to reach a deal, so the closure and its supply premium remain in place. Friday's leadership was dispersed rather than one-way, with Microsoft closing at its highest level of the year while Meta fell 3.3%, which argues against aligned breadth as a Tail amplifier. The coming week carries JOLTS and consumer confidence on Tuesday, August PCE with final Q2 GDP on Wednesday, ISM Manufacturing on Thursday and September payrolls on Friday, with consensus near 100,000 jobs and a 4.2% unemployment rate; Micron reports fiscal Q4 after the close on September 30. Those are forward checkpoints that raise Stress and shape Confidence; under this contract they do not by themselves raise Tail before a price path is observed. Shared Finviz context was read at the start of this run and sits at the edge of the 90-minute freshness window; it reports collectionStatus partial with both its futures and calendar sections unavailable. Its latest-session breadth, megacap and semiconductor readings were used only as explicitly non-real-time confirmation of Friday's dispersed leadership and firm semiconductor tone, and every level quoted above comes from a primary source verified directly during this run.

lookbackSummary: Across the trailing 24 published hours the Claude state ranged between Tail 8 and 22 and never approached the block threshold. The opening overnight stretch from 03:00Z to 05:00Z held Tail at 18 in normal conditions. The European and US cash stretch from 06:00Z to 14:00Z produced four trend-up prints and a run of WATCH states at Tail 20-22 as the index worked higher, and the 13:00Z slot has no published assessment and is marked unavailable rather than reconstructed. From 15:00Z conditions settled back to mixed at Tail 18-19, and the final six hours fell to Tail 12, 10, 10, 9, 9 and 8 as CME futures settled into the weekend closure and no tradable price path remained. Stress ranged between 45 and 58, holding in the mid-50s through the cash session before easing steadily to 45 by the last published hour, and Confidence held between 84 and 88 throughout.
outlookSummary: The entire published window falls inside the scheduled CME weekend closure: futures settled at 21:00Z on Friday and do not reopen until 22:00Z on Sunday, roughly twenty hours past the final slot. Tail is held between 7 and 9 for all 24 hours because sustained mean-reversion failure requires a tradable price path, and none of the inherited amplifiers, shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension, or an index pinned near an extreme, can be observed while every Nasdaq-100 venue is shut. Stress eases from 45 to 42 through the deepest part of the closure and firms back to 48 by the final hours as the reopen and a week carrying PCE, final Q2 GDP, ISM Manufacturing and September payrolls approach. Confidence decays from 83 to 69 across the window because later hours sit progressively further from the verified Friday evidence set, while the exchange calendar anchoring the low Tail stays certain. Weekend geopolitical or diplomatic developments, above all a US response to Iran's Hormuz terms, would transmit only as headlines within this window; their earliest possible price expression is the Sunday reopen, which lies outside it.
